slides.texte_overlay:
How to completely rebuild
your life in 3 months

Own your evenings | Wind-down:
•Phone out of the bedroom.
•Lights low after 10.
•Tomorrow's plan on paper.
•Same bedtime, even Fridays.

Repair your relationships | People:
•Apologize to one person you hurt.
•Call your parents every week.
•Plan one dinner a month.
•Drop the friends who only take.

Clean up your spending | Habits:
•Cancel what you don't use.
•Wait 48 hours before buying.
•Cook more, order less.
•Keep one simple budget.

Keep learning | Growth:
•One book a month.
•One new skill this quarter.
•Learn a little every day.
•Teach someone what you learn.
